newsitem.title: CANADA: Band-Ore Resources up on exposure, rumors.
newsitem.headline: Band-Ore Resources up on exposure, rumors.

text.p: Band-Ore Resources Ltd bounded ahead in morning trading on Thursday as it attracted attention from new investors at a trade show.
Takeover rumors about the Toronto-based gold exploration company also put a spotlight on the stock.
Shares in Band-Ore rose C$1.25 to C$13.50 in the first two hours of trading, gaining more than 10 percent of its value.
"It's exposure," said Band-Ore president Wayne O'Connor.
Band-Ore is a new listing on the Toronto Stock Exchange. Today is Band-Ore's third day of trading.
The company is also working to heighten its profile at a gold show in Timmins, Ontario, where Band-Ore has an exploration property near known gold deposits.
The property has sparked inquiries from other gold miners and institutional investors, said O'Connor.
Analysts said the company is rumored to be a takeover target, but they said exploration of the property is still in its early stages.
